definitions.explanation: A state of being completely absorbed in something pleasurable, losing oneself in an experience. Can refer to alcohol intoxication or figurative intoxication with art, beauty, or ideas.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}に{陶酔|とうすい}している。
{自分|じぶん}の{成功|せいこう}に{陶酔|とうすい}するな。
examples.english: Don't get intoxicated with your own success.

examples.japanese: {陶酔|とうすい}{状態|じょうたい}で{演奏|えんそう}した。
examples.english: I performed in a state of rapture.

notes:
{陶酔|とうすい} contains {陶|とう} (pottery/to mold) and {酔|すい} (drunk), suggesting being shaped or molded by the experience of intoxication.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {陶酔|とうすい}する: to be intoxicated, to be enraptured
- ～に{陶酔|とうすい}する: to be intoxicated by ~
- {自己|じこ}{陶酔|とうすい}: self-intoxication, narcissism

CONTRAST:
- {酔|よ}う: to get drunk (more literal)
- {恍惚|こうこつ}: ecstasy (more intense)
- {夢中|むちゅう}: absorbed in (less intense)
